purpose: Probe the boundary near the existing 250ms owner-retirement grace and record a completion/cancellation race if present. Instrumentation now preserves terminal.completed and contradictory cancellation/liveness receipts instead of aborting.
scope_limit: Private Xvfb and synthetic app only. Timing is a fixture-controlled XTEST delay, not network or natural OS delivery.
stop_rule: one attempt; retain all output; no retry.
